Using curl for a health check or version request from the main GitHub endpoint in parallel could be effective. I might need to request an environment session endpoint, but if it's configured but inaccessible, I need to be aware of that issue as I proceed. It's something to follow up on!

I have your approval to deploy. I’ll first capture the current live proof, then submit the complete authorized release through the IVX autonomous worker; it requires a valid owner session to do that safely.
